name: URTC-DOCS
notes: The documentation and cross-repository tooling hub of the URTC ecosystem: the architecture, the interfaces, the security baseline, the threat model, the capability matrix and a study note on the three implementations of the CAN protocol, written from what the other repositories document and marked where a statement could not be traced. Tools (standard library only): a project catalogue generated from the manifests of the repositories found next to it, a banner, icon and ecosystem map generator, a generator of its own eight READMEs, a publication check for anything private, and a script that runs every repository's own CI validation and prints one PASS, FAIL or SKIP line each. Scaffolding on purpose: the tools are unit-tested and run in CI, but the nightly comparison of all the repositories has not yet been exercised over time.
